title: Getting Started with Tempo.Blazor
overview: Tempo.Blazor is a comprehensive Blazor WebAssembly component library providing 100+ UI components for building modern web applications. It includes inputs, forms, data tables, pickers, charts, layout, navigation, feedback, workflow designer, scheduler, and more. All components use the Tm prefix (e.g., TmButton, TmDataTable).
platform: Blazor WebAssembly, Blazor Server, and InteractiveAuto (hybrid rendering)

renderModes.description: Tempo.Blazor supports all Blazor render modes.

modes.name: InteractiveWebAssembly
modes.description: Full client-side rendering in the browser via WebAssembly.

modes.name: InteractiveServer
modes.description: Server-side rendering with SignalR connection for interactivity.

modes.name: InteractiveAuto
modes.description: Starts with Server rendering, switches to WebAssembly once downloaded. Recommended for best UX.

renderModes.notes: Components with JS interop (dashboard, workflow designer, rich editor, scheduler, PDF viewer, diagram editor, color picker, file manager, Gantt, Notion editor, document editor, signing, spreadsheet, wireframe designer, and email variable insertion) gracefully degrade during prerendering and activate once the client-side runtime is available.

cssFramework.description: Tempo.Blazor uses its own standalone CSS framework based on CSS custom properties (design tokens). No external CSS framework (like Bootstrap or Tailwind) is required. The library ships a single tempo-blazor.bundled.css file that includes all component styles, design tokens, base resets, and animations.
cssFramework.architecture: The CSS is organized as: tokens (design variables) → base resets → component styles. Each component uses BEM-like class naming with the tm- prefix (e.g., tm-btn, tm-data-table, tm-modal__header).

darkMode.description: Dark mode is supported via CSS custom property overrides. Activate by adding data-theme="dark" attribute or .tm-dark class to a parent element (typically <html> or <body>).
darkMode.themeService: Use the ThemeService (registered via DI) to toggle themes programmatically.

designTokens.description: All visual properties are controlled via CSS custom properties (--tm-*). Override these to customize the look and feel without modifying component CSS.

colorPrimary.description: Primary brand color palette (blue by default)

borders.description: Border colors. --tm-border-color is the decorative divider tone; the boundary of a selection control (checkbox, radio, multiselect option), which conveys the control's state, uses --tm-border-color-control so it stays above the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 minimum. Retheming a control must go through the -control token, not through --tm-border-color. --tm-control-hover-fill is the fill an UNCHECKED control takes while hovered: the hover used to recolour the outline only, which is a hue change of ~1.05:1 and therefore invisible in greyscale. A palette override must keep the hovered outline (--tm-color-primary) at 3:1 against this fill.

typography.description: Font families, sizes, weights, and line heights

tokens.--tm-font-mono: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', 'Source Code Pro', Menlo, monospace

customization.description: Override design tokens in your app CSS to customize the theme globally.

localization.description: Tempo.Blazor supports localization via the ITmLocalizer interface (namespace Tempo.Blazor.Localization, defined in Tempo.Blazor.Abstractions). All built-in component UI strings (button labels, tooltips, placeholders, validation messages, aria-labels, etc.) go through this interface. The library ships with 500+ localization keys covering all components.

architecture.interface: ITmLocalizer — two indexer overloads: this[string key] for simple lookups, this[string key, params object[] arguments] for formatted strings (e.g. Loc["TmImageGallery_Counter", 5, 20] → "5 of 20").
architecture.defaultImplementation: DefaultTmLocalizer (internal) — backed by IStringLocalizer<TmResources> using embedded .resx files (TmResources.resx for English, TmResources.cs.resx for Czech).
architecture.injection: All components get the localizer via @inject ITmLocalizer Loc in the library's _Imports.razor. Components then use Loc["KeyName"] in markup and code.
architecture.registration: AddTempoBlazor() registers: (1) ITmLocalizer as Singleton (stateless, thread-safe, backed by .resx), (2) ThemeService as Scoped (per-circuit in Server, per-tab in WASM), (3) ToastService as Scoped (per-circuit in Server, per-tab in WASM). Uses TryAdd* so your custom registrations take precedence if registered AFTER AddTempoBlazor().

localization.keyNamingConvention: Keys follow the pattern Tm[ComponentName]_[Action/State]. Shared keys use Tm_ prefix (e.g. Tm_Save, Tm_Cancel, Tm_Loading). Component-specific keys include the component name (e.g. TmDataTable_NoResults, TmRichEditor_Bold, TmFilterBuilder_Contains).

keyCategories.shared: Tm_Loading, Tm_Close, Tm_Cancel, Tm_Save, Tm_Delete, Tm_Confirm, Tm_NoResults, Tm_Error, Tm_Retry, Tm_Search, Tm_Clear, Tm_Select, Tm_SelectAll, Tm_DeselectAll, Tm_Edit, Tm_Add, Tm_Remove, Tm_Apply, Tm_Reset, Tm_Previous, Tm_Next, Tm_Download, Tm_Upload, Tm_Create, Tm_Optional, Tm_Required, Tm_Yes, Tm_No
keyCategories.dataTable: TmDataTable_NoResults, TmDataTable_Loading, TmDataTable_PageSize, TmDataTable_SearchPlaceholder, TmDataTable_ShowingItems, TmDataTable_SelectAll, TmDataTable_DeselectAll, TmDataTable_BulkActions, TmDataTable_ExpandAll, TmDataTable_CollapseAll, TmDataTable_GroupDropPlaceholder
keyCategories.richEditor: TmRichEditor_Bold, TmRichEditor_Italic, TmRichEditor_Underline, TmRichEditor_Undo, TmRichEditor_Redo, TmRichEditor_InsertLink, TmRichEditor_InsertImage, TmRichEditor_InsertTable, etc. (56 keys total)
keyCategories.filterBuilder: TmFilterBuilder_Equals, TmFilterBuilder_NotEquals, TmFilterBuilder_Contains, TmFilterBuilder_StartsWith, TmFilterBuilder_Between, TmFilterBuilder_GreaterThan, TmFilterBuilder_LessThan, TmFilterBuilder_In, TmFilterBuilder_NotIn, etc.
keyCategories.pickers: TmDatePicker_Today, TmDatePicker_Clear, TmTimePicker_Hours, TmTimePicker_Minutes, TmDateRangePicker_LastWeek, TmDateRangePicker_LastMonth, TmDateRangePicker_ThisYear, etc.
keyCategories.other: TmAlert_Dismiss, TmButton_Loading, TmSearchInput_Placeholder, TmNotificationBell_*, TmViewManager_*, TmDashboard_*, TmPasswordStrength_*, TmActivity_*, TmTimeline_*, etc.

switchLanguage.description: Set the culture in Program.cs before builder.Build(). This makes IStringLocalizer pick the correct .resx file automatically.

customLocalizer.description: To fully replace all component strings (e.g. for a language not shipped with the library), implement ITmLocalizer and register it AFTER AddTempoBlazor(). The TryAddSingleton in AddTempoBlazor() will be skipped if your registration comes first.

partialOverride.description: To override only specific keys while keeping the rest from the built-in resources, create a decorator that falls back to the default implementation.

addNewLanguage.description: To add a new language (e.g. German), implement ITmLocalizer with all keys translated. You can export the English .resx keys as a reference. Since DefaultTmLocalizer is internal, a full custom implementation is the recommended approach for new languages.
